headline: Linn Mercy Rekindles as Weathered Expanse Holds Wire
war_summary: The latest wires show Linn Mercy stirring anew with five changes in the last two hours about Outwich Ranch and Lathair for two Warden, eight Colonial and one destroyed holding, latest logged at 1141, while the Weathered Expanse remains the busiest desk with one change in two hours, eighteen in six and fifty-one in the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk for six Warden, one Colonial and two destroyed, last entry at 1156. Kuura Strand breaks silence with one late change at 1013 about Talven and Faden Point, ten in the day. Nevish Line, with fifty-six in the day about Blackcoat Way, Princefal and Blinding Stones for seven Warden and one Colonial, records nothing in six hours, last at 0504, and Marban Hollow likewise shows none in six hours with eight in the day about Checkpoint Bua, last at 0546. Godcrofts and Mooring County log nothing in two hours, their 0851 entries aging, and Callahan's Passage reports 5,853 Colonial and 3,625 Warden casualties in the day without a recorded transfer.
